plan:
Enforce [sql_identifiers] by accepting only users or orders as table_name; reject every other name with ValueError before constructing any SQL. Raise ValueError if limit is outside 1 through 100. Open the SQLite database at database_path, execute SELECT * FROM the validated table identifier ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ?, binding limit as a query parameter, fetch the resulting rows, and return them as a list of tuples.
END_PLAN
